# skills.rest
> 645,000+ vetted AI agent skills for ChatGPT, Claude, Codex & Gemini. One click to connect the library to your AI agent. Use on demand.

## What is skills.rest?

skills.rest is a curated, open library of executable AI agent skills. Each skill is a self-contained, installable package that extends the capabilities of AI agents like Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, OpenClaw, and Gemini. Skills cover 10 professional domains and are contributed by official tech leaders (Microsoft, Anthropic, AWS, Nvidia, Google), verified authors, and the community.

## Key Features

- 645,000+ vetted and indexed agent skills
- One-click installation via npx, pnpm, and bun
- 10 professional domain categories
- Supports Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, Antigravity, and custom AI agents
- Free to use, community-driven

## How to Install a Skill

**CLI (recommended):**
Run the install command shown on any skill detail page in your terminal (Bash/Zsh or PowerShell):
`npx skills add <repo_url> --skill <skill_slug>`

**Agent Integration:**
Use the Agent Connect helper on https://skills.rest to automatically install the skill discovery helper directly into your agent's skills directory.

## Categories

- Content & Communication — Writing, editing, social media management
- Data & Analytics — Data processing, visualization, analysis
- Design & Creative — Art generation, image editing, creative concepts
- Education & Research — Academic research, summarization, learning aids
- Finance & Accounting — Financial modeling, bookkeeping, market analysis
- Legal & Compliance — Contract review, regulatory checks, legal research
- Marketing & Sales — SEO, email campaigns, customer relationship tools
- Personal & Entrepreneur — Productivity, organization, startup resources
- Product & Management — Roadmapping, user stories, agile workflows
- Software Engineering — Code generation, debugging, documentation
